selection: First E1 held recording in immutable manifest order; not selected by prediction outcome.

representation_rule.operation: 10*log10(max(mean(abs(H_scaled)**2 over each five exported subcarriers), epsilon_power))
representation_rule.scaling: Original author/Halperin sqrt(SNR) scaling, same RSSI/AGC/noise handling as prepare_data.py
representation_rule.bands: Three RX antennas x six consecutive exported-subcarrier groups of five = 18 streams
representation_rule.resampling: Linear interpolation to 500 equally spaced valid packet-index positions per record; physical duration/timestamp gaps are not preserved
representation_rule.fitting: None. No pooled source or target statistics. Each record transformed independently by the fixed formula.
representation_rule.labels: No labels or model predictions used by conversion; manifest file order and hash receipts only.
